question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Brutal
solution:
The correct answer is: **Ruthless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Brutal"** means harsh, cruel, or extremely violent. It is used to describe actions or behavior lacking compassion or mercy. (क्रूर)

 
 
• **Example:** The dictator's brutal policies led to widespread suffering among the people.
 
 
 
• **"Ruthless"** refers to showing no pity or compassion for others. It is synonymous with "Brutal" as both imply a lack of mercy or kindness. (निर्दयी)
 
 
• **Example:** The ruthless leader crushed any opposition to his rule without hesitation.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"Brutal"** is **"Ruthless"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Ruthless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Active** (सक्रिय): Energetic or involved in action.

 
 
• **Example:** She is very active in community service and volunteers regularly.
 
 
 
• **Heroic** (वीरता): Showing courage and determination, often in challenging situations.
 
 
• **Example:** His heroic efforts saved many lives during the disaster.
 
 
 
• **Notable** (उल्लेखनीय): Worthy of attention or significant.
 
 
• **Example:** The scientist made notable contributions to the field of medicine.
